newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-BIRZHU BUYS INTO KAUNO SURINE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-BIRZHU BUYS INTO KAUNO SURINE.

text.p: Lithuania's Birzhu Dairy said on Monday that it has bought the state's 40 percent stake in Kaunas cheese producing firm Kauno Surine and that it wanted eventually to buy a majority in the company.
"Today we acquired a 40 percent stake in Kauno Surine for 719,000 litas in an auction on the stock exchange," Vladas Songaila, Birzhu director general, told Reuters.
The initial price for the share portfolio of Kauno Surine stood at 710,000 litas.
"We paid a reasonable price for the company," Songaila said.
"Today and tomorrow we will continue to buy shares from the employees of the firm and we intend to acquire more than 51 percent in the company," Songaila added.
Songaila said that Kauno Surine is a small Kaunas firm producing various kind of cheese with skilled personnel.
"At the same time we acquired the premises necessary for the distribution of our products in the region," Songaila said.
Birzhu Dairy is one of the three corporates listed on the elite official list of five member Vilnius bourse.
